_comment: Read by prefetch_hf_models.py from the workflow's own commit, never from a PR. It downloads every loadable file of a repo at main unless the repo's entry here names `revisions` (instead of main), `patterns` (the only files to fetch), or `skip` (why it is never prefetched).

meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NV.skip: its stage downloads it with HF_MUSE_SPARK_TOKEN, never on PR runs
